plan.diagnosis_summary: node_1 has three genuine faults: unmapped aliases (rx_jitter_index/syn_reply_interval/payload_confirm_delay statistically matching missing djit/synack/ackdat), a clean 1000x unit inflation on sbytes/dbytes/dload (conservation ratios exactly 1000.0, benign-anchor log10 ratios 2.98-3.01, while smean/dmean/spkts and sload remain at scale), and 412 corrupted rows (NaN/negative, 1.72%). collector_tag_score is a local shortcut (MI_norm 1.0002 on node_3 vs 0.0054 median, robust_z 49.7) and must be dropped globally; with it excluded, node_3 shows sharply elevated label noise (suspected 0.2009, conflict 0.1302, self-confidence 0.4623 vs peer 0.817-0.819) while node_2 and node_4 stay near baseline, so only node_3 needs label cleaning. node_4's class mix (sole holder of Analysis/Backdoor/Shellcode/Worms) is legitimate Non-IID, not a fault.
